content: I can explain ArtVault workflows, but I cannot access another person's private information or change roles, payments, orders or stock. Never share passwords, OTPs or payment credentials here.

Use Sign Up, enter your details and send the email OTP. Verify the complete code, then choose Create Account. Sign in manually using the exact registered email. Never share your password or OTP in chat.

ArtVault currently supports Razorpay TEST payments only. Open your unpaid order to see eligible test-payment actions. Only trusted server verification can confirm payment; a browser success screen alone is not proof. UPI/live payments and automated refunds are not offered here. I do not read or change your payment status.

Choose a complete saved shipping address before creating an unpaid order. Prices and available stock are validated by the server. Reservations have a payment deadline and are released by trusted expiry processing. If the window expires, use the existing recovery flow; chat cannot reactivate it.

Sign in and open My Orders for your own current order, payment and shipment information. Shipping is manual tracking where provided. TEST purchases cannot be dispatched as real purchases. I cannot look up, cancel or change an order in this chat.

Open an artwork and add an available item to your cart. Review quantities and totals, then sign in to checkout with a saved address. Adding to cart does not reserve stock; availability is checked again by the server.

Open Auctions for the current schedule and eligible lots. Bids must meet the server's minimum and time window; sellers cannot bid on their own work. Only the winning account can open winner checkout. Chat cannot place bids, reveal private bidder IDs or invent auction results.

Open a published artwork and choose View in AR when its asset and your device are supported. Android WebXR requires a compatible device and secure connection. Reposition and resize, then Lock Position; Unlock Position lets you move it again. Displayed dimensions are estimated, not camera-measured.

Apply to become a seller from your account. Approved sellers use Seller Studio to create drafts, upload images and submit work for trusted admin moderation. Submitting does not publish automatically. Chat cannot approve sellers or publish artworks.

Open an artwork's analysis page for available supported findings. Heuristic ranking uses metadata and engagement; it is not visual AI analysis, an authenticity certificate or an objective artistic-quality score. No visual model is connected to this assistant.
Use the artist link on an artwork to open the artist's public profile. Follow artists you like to shape your recommendations. I do not invent biographies or claims about an artist's identity.

Explore supports search, categories and price filters. Recommendations use eligible published artworks, real engagement and your own likes, wishlist and follows when signed in. Guest discovery uses public signals. These are explainable heuristic suggestions, not deep-learning personalization.

I provide local FAQ guidance about ArtVault, not live AI-generated answers. Ask about signup, artists, artworks, cart, checkout, orders, TEST payments, auctions or AR. For current prices and availability, open the corresponding ArtVault page.
